messages:
Anna: Heads up — after GA we have two high-signal follow-ons: 1) embed result drift impacting 2 large customers, 2) suggestions pane UX polish that reduces clicks. Need quick decision for the next 2-week miniwave. My proposal: 1 week hotfix for embed + 1 week UX polish (so customers get mitigation fast). Thoughts? cc @Josh @Maria @Kevin

Josh: We can do the embed fix + a fallback in 1 week if we lock scope. Looks like a model-version/tokenization fallback issue + KV cache consistency. Will need SRE signoff for cache invalidation window.

Maria: SRE perspective — cache invalidation during peak is risky. Recommend staged canary + explicit fallback. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with health gates. Monitor p95/p99 latency and embed similarity metric. Rollback if sim drops >5% or errors spike.

Kevin: QA: need reproducible repros from both customers before we cut the hotfix. Also want an E2E that asserts top-N embed similarity >= 0.85 for representative queries. For suggestions UX, acceptance should be telemetry-based (avg clicks per flow down by >=1) and no conversion regressions.

Sam: Alternative option — 1-week hotfix (embed only), then 1-week dedicated polish. Upside: faster customer mitigation. Downside: context switching for Eng/QA. I lean toward the rapid hotfix.

Anna: :thumbsup: I prefer Sam's split (hotfix first). Action items: Josh will own embed hotfix, Kevin collects customer repros and builds E2E, Maria prepares canary + runbook, I'll draft acceptance criteria + timeline and update roadmap.

Josh: I'll own embed. Pushing the internal issue with repros here: https://redwood.internal/issue/5432 (internal). Quick triage command: `gh issue 5432 label --add embed-regression`

Maria: Canary plan sketch: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 48h with automated health checks. Health checks: p99 latency < 2.2s, error rate < 0.1%, embed sim delta >= -5% relative to baseline. I'll add rollback steps to the runbook.

Kevin: QA ETA — I can produce the harness and pytest E2E in ~3 working days after I get customer logs/repro. QA will block merge until E2E passes.

Anna: Timing proposal: start Monday, hotfix deploy Tue (canary), polish week starts the following Mon. If no objections I’ll post the plan to the roadmap doc and carve tickets.

Josh: ok from eng.

Maria: ok from SRE — will reserve Tue night canary window to avoid peak traffic.

Sam: I'll draft customer comms and set expectations (ETA + rollback plan).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary job created for 5% rollout on 1836000540 — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9987

Anna: Thanks team. I’ll open the roadmap PR and assign tickets: embed-hotfix (ENG-1245), e2e-harness (QA-421), canary-runbook (SRE-88). I’ll also update the backlog deep-dive doc with prioritization rationale: fix-first for customer-critical regressions, polish after mitigation.
